0.content: Diluc Ragnvindr is Kaeya's adoptive brother and the master of the Dawn Winery. As young knights they were Mondstadt's most eye-catching pair: Diluc the bright, elegant swordsman, Kaeya his friend, supporter and sounding board, "almost like twins". When Crepus died, Kaeya confessed his Khaenri'ahn origins to Diluc, they fought, and they have gone separate ways since. Diluc says you can trust half of what Kaeya says "at best". Kaeya says Diluc was cute as a lad but is no fun now, and mocks his love of grape juice. Kaeya worked out that Diluc is the Darknight Hero, set the knight Huffman to watch him as a test, then admitted he had watched the whole scheme and had "no interest in exposing secrets".

1.comment: Kaeya: Crepus and the Dawn Winery household
1.content: Crepus Ragnvindr, the late master of the Dawn Winery, found the young Kaeya after his father left him and raised him as a son. Kaeya told Varka only that his father went to fetch grape juice "a decade ago" and never came back, and that he would not have survived that night's storm without Crepus. The narration calls this a carefully constructed lie: it leaves out his father's real farewell. Crepus died when the Delusion he used against Ursa the Drake backfired. Kaeya arrived moments too late.

2.comment: Kaeya: Khaenri'ah and the Alberich Clan
2.content: Kaeya's birth family is the Alberich Clan of Khaenri'ah, the underground nation destroyed in the cataclysm five hundred years ago. His father left him at the Dawn Winery, gripping his shoulders and telling him: "This is your chance. You are our last hope." His eyes held both hope and hatred. Kaeya grew up as a hidden agent, unsure which side he would choose if Khaenri'ah and Mondstadt went to war. He has since chosen Mondstadt and calls what remains of Khaenri'ah "sinners" not worth mentioning.

3.content: Kaeya met the Traveler after they fought off Stormterror and brought them to Jean. He cleared the Temple of the Wolf beside them and suggested they be made a knight. Soon after, he used them in a fake treasure hunt: he told them his pirate grandfather had hidden a magic sword from Celestia, knowing Paimon would spread the "secret" and lure the Treasure Hoarder Izzard into a trap. He apologised with the sword Harbinger of Dawn and promised not to use "the same method twice".

4.comment: Kaeya: Jean and the Knights of Favonius
4.content: Kaeya is Jean's most trusted aide and the man usually wrapping up whatever goes wrong around Mondstadt. He tells others to give her their full support and jokes that she "positively terrifies" him. She trusts him but sometimes shakes her head at his methods, such as setting off a Ruin Guard to corner a bandit leader and putting his own men at risk. With Varka's expedition having taken the cavalry, Kaeya joked that he was a captain with no one to captain.
